articles.headline: Akamai signs $11.6 billion cloud deal with Anthropic
articles.summary: Akamai landed an $11.6 billion cloud services contract with Anthropic and issued a warrant that could give Anthropic up to 5% of the company. The deal matters for businesses because it signals rising AI infrastructure demand, may support Akamai’s growth, and pushed the stock sharply higher in trading.

articles.headline: OpenAI to preview GPT-6 Cyber within days
articles.summary: OpenAI is planning a cybersecurity-focused model and a product to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically. That is relevant for enterprises because it points to new AI security tooling that could affect cyber defense, compliance, and operational risk management.

articles.headline: BNP Paribas will keep sensitive data off public cloud despite Google deal
articles.summary: BNP Paribas said it will keep some sensitive customer data and critical operations off public cloud infrastructure even after signing a five-year cloud and AI partnership with Google. The move highlights how regulated businesses are balancing AI adoption against data-residency, security, and operational control concerns.
